_what: Weeks of an UNBACKFILLABLE capture that are permanently lost, accepted in writing so the alarm can clear and a NEW loss is visible against them.
_why_this_file_exists: The weekly capture guard failed on EVERY run for its first five days and
commented on issue #31 four times with byte-identical content: archive weeks
[2, 3, 4] and props week [2]. Those weeks cannot be captured — the evidence
does not exist later — so the guard could never clear, and an alarm that
cannot clear is the wallpaper its own header was written against:
'a red workflow sitting in a list of red workflows is invisible'.
Worse than noise: with the guard already red and #31 already open, a NEW
loss in week 6 would have been invisible INSIDE the standing failure. That
is the precise harm the guard exists to prevent, arriving through the guard.
The audit's own closing line already prescribed the fix — 'Fix the capture,
then ACCEPT THE GAP IN WRITING rather than letting it go unnoticed.' This is
that writing. Same shape as test_proj_series_completeness.py's triage, which
this repo had already learned once: a permanent gap must stop holding a gate
_rules: ONLY unbackfillable captures may appear here. A backfillable gap (the
realized stores — nflverse keeps its history) must be FETCHED, not accepted;
accepting one would hide work rather than record a loss, and the test
Every entry carries `why` and `accepted_on`. An undated acceptance is how a
Accepting a week does NOT silence any other week. The guard still goes red,
and still opens an issue, for any missing week that is not listed here.

gaps.why: Sleeper's projections and stats were fetched from the /v1 surface, which answers 200 with a well-formed body and ZERO projections in it. Both 2027-gradeable captures saw '7630 rows, 0 with stats', correctly refused to bank an empty week, and went red every run from kickoff. Root-caused 2026-10-07 (the base URL, not the paths) and fixed; week 5 landed complete on 2026-10-08. Weeks 2-4 are gone: a pre-kickoff projection cannot be reconstructed after the games are played, and a retroactive pull is not provably the pre-kickoff number (exp33).
gaps.cost: The January-2027 experiment — our weekly model against Sleeper and FantasyPros on this league's scoring — loses three of its weeks. It is graded on weeks 1 and 5 onward.

gaps.why: Same window as the archive loss. The free props writer missed week 2 while the Sleeper surface defect was live; weeks 3, 4 and 5 are captured and the writer has run green since.
gaps.cost: One week of market-implied weekly points, out of the season the in-season edge plan ranks first. Weeks 1, 3, 4, 5+ remain.
